new.s:
Consider the following statements about Bitcoin:
1. Bitcoins are tracked by the central banks of countries.
2. Bitcoin transactions are validated through mining.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Bitcoin is decentralised and is not tracked by central banks; its transactions are validated by mining.

new.s: Which of the following cities was NOT among the cities of the retail e-rupee (e₹-R) pilot that began on 1 December 2022?
new.x: The retail e-rupee pilot began in a closed user group in Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru and Bhubaneswar; Hyderabad was not among them.

new.s: Which Hyderabad-based institution was a partner, along with C-DAC and VJTI Mumbai, in MeitY's Distributed Centre of Excellence in Blockchain?
new.x: MeitY's Distributed Centre of Excellence in Blockchain involved C-DAC, IDRBT Hyderabad and VJTI Mumbai.

new.s: Which law brought in the 30% tax on gains from virtual digital assets in India?
new.x: The Finance Act, 2022 brought the 30% tax on VDA gains (Section 115BBH) and 1% TDS on transfers (Section 194S).

new.s: What is the loud bang heard when an aircraft flies faster than the speed of sound called?
new.x: A sonic boom is the shock-wave bang made by an object moving faster than sound, such as a supersonic aircraft.
new.angle: APPSC PYQ yc6e998674a3 Sonic boom angle

new.s: Which of the following works on the principle of total internal reflection?
new.x: An endoscope, like an optical fibre, carries light by total internal reflection.
new.angle: U0710 #1 Optical fibre -> working principle (TIR uses)

new.s:
Consider the following statements about total internal reflection:
1. It takes place when light travels from a denser medium to a rarer medium.
2. It takes place only when the angle of incidence is less than the critical angle.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Total internal reflection needs light going from a denser to a rarer medium with the angle of incidence greater than the critical angle.

new.s: What is 'network slicing' in 5G?
o: Dividing spectrum among operators through auctions
Cutting optical fibre into segments for repeaters
Sharing one tower between two operators
Splitting one physical network into several virtual networks
new.x: Network slicing splits one 5G network into virtual slices, each suited to a different use.

new.s: Who developed Bluetooth technology in 1994?
new.x: Bluetooth, which works at 2.4 GHz, was developed in 1994 by Jaap Haartsen; Harald Haas coined the term Li-Fi.
new.angle: U0710 #6 Wireless access technologies -> developer (notes gap)

new.s: Which of the following does NOT use the licence-free 2.4 GHz ISM band?
new.x: Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cordless phones and microwave ovens use the 2.4-2.5 GHz ISM band; FM radio uses about 88-108 MHz.
new.angle: U0710 #6 Wireless access -> ISM band (notes gap)

new.s: In which year was the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) created when Posts and Telecom were split?
new.x: DoT was created in 1985 when Posts and Telecom were split; C-DOT came in 1984 and MTNL/VSNL in 1986.

new.s: Which technology does TRAI prefer for vehicle communication?
new.x: TRAI prefers C-V2X (cellular vehicle-to-everything) for communication between vehicles.

new.s: What does the term IoT stand for?
new.x: IoT means Internet of Things: devices networked to communicate without human intervention.

new.s: Smart homes and connected appliances are examples of which technology?
new.x: Smart homes and connected appliances are uses of the Internet of Things (IoT).

new.s: Who invented the World Wide Web?
new.x: Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web; Klaus Schwab coined '4IR' and Toffler wrote of the 'Third Wave'.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the ITU/3GPP use cases of 5G?
new.x: The 5G use cases are eMBB, URLLC and mMTC; GPRS is a 2.5G data technology.

new.s: Which company provided the radio network in the indigenous Bharat Telecom Stack?
new.x: In the Bharat Telecom Stack, C-DOT built the core, Tejas Networks the radio and TCS did integration; BSNL deployed it.
